name: Newlat Food S.p.A.
summary: Newlat Food S.p.A. operates in the agri-food sector in Italy and internationally. The company offers pasta, rusks, toast, milk, yogurt, butter, cheese, protein and gluten free products, and childhood products. It offers its products under the 3 GLOCKEN, ala, Birkel, Buitoni, Centrale del Latte, CICCARESE, Corticella, DELVERDE, Fior di Salento, Giglio, Guacci, G√É¬úDO, Krokkis, Matese, Optimus, Pezzullo, Polenghi, and Torre in Pietra brands through direct deposits and dealers. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Reggio Emilia, Italy.
